root_cause: Daily Growth Intelligence performed independent awaited PostgREST POST calls for every company, relationship, market-whitespace relation, prediction, obligation and scorecard. Such sequential writes can exceed the existing 30-second Netlify scheduled-function limit even after the real missing-credential blocker was fixed. The 2026-10-23 06:00 UTC 502 provider log proves the prior credential blocker, not a measured timeout from the new live release.
fix: Use one bounded in-invocation deduplicated writeback buffer targeting existing canonical tables, flush after decision+scorecard construction, propagate any database failures, no terminal success without flush. Keep original 06:00 UTC schedule and current scoring/attribution logic unchanged.
prevention_rule: Large daily Brain/revenue loops must not make unbounded sequential network writes; use bounded upserts with exact natural-key deduplication, mark execution complete only after durable write acknowledgment, never fabricate a daily result or install a second scheduler.

invariants: dedupe by canonical table conflict key
no duplicate CRM, false outcome or revenue
